name: Announcements
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; 5 of 44 local client repos ship an in-app announcement/banner surface, every one hand-rolled)
description: Scheduled in-app announcements shown as a dismissible banner or a modal, with per-user dismissal that survives a reload and a project-defined audience resolver. Optionally emails the announcement when it is published.

delivery.prompt: Should publishing an announcement also email it?

in-app.label: In-app only — banner and modal, nothing leaves the app

in-app+email.label: In-app and email — publishing queues a mail to the resolved audience
